summary.text: Duron Jackson is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Chris Miller; no incumbent is seeking the seat.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary, in which he received 44.5 percent of the vote.
